tool_args.rationale: The bridge-thermal-fin and flux-conservation signatures point to a coupled transfer mechanism, but five observations at a single horizon and fixed auxiliary inputs leave genuine identifiability ambiguity. An open-branch discriminating probe is the most targeted available next measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary curve to the five observed u_now values
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The inputs vary only in u_now; constant x_now, u_past, mem_conv, s_grad, and H cannot identify a two-hop transfer or distinguish its open-branch behavior.
A fine trajectory batch costs more and is less targeted than a probe designed to discriminate branch behavior.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
